Rivet Volley
data.description: The Hullbound Mender's steady attack: three skyglass rivets, wherever you stand.
data.battleDescription: %user thumbs three skyglass rivets from his pouch and drives them into %target.

data.name: Keel Splitter: Port
data.description: Marks the port half of the hold (the left six columns). It splits next turn.
data.battleDescription: %user snaps a chalk line down the keel. "Port side."

effects.description: Telegraph: the port half splits next turn

data.description: Marks the starboard half of the hold (the right six columns). It splits next turn.

data.name: Keel Splits: Port

data.name: Fresh Planks
data.description: Lays three warm new planks inside the hold. Stand on one before he swings.

data.name: Hammerfall
data.description: Slams the whole deck. A fresh plank takes most of it; the hull makes it worse.
